focus: Vega-Lite v1/v4 versus current axis and scale defaults
noveltyJustification: The versioned pages are valid historical sources but v1 label defaults are not current; current docs retain parity/greedy and color defaults with renamed/changed label properties.
keyQuestions: Are the cited v1 and v4 paths the right place for the claims?
What label and color defaults changed, and does the pinned corpus approximate them?
answeredQuestions: v1 documents -45 degree time/ordinal labels and labelMaxLength 25; this is historical only.
v4 documents parity/greedy overlap and labelLimit 180, and its color defaults are tableau10/blues/viridis/blues by field type.
Current docs use -90 for nominal/ordinal labels, pixel labelLimit, and the same parity/greedy model and color defaults.
The corpus uses fixed per-form thinning and local palettes rather than runtime guide/scale generation.
ruledOutDirections: Using v1 defaults as current behavior.
Describing fixed index thinning as a generic parity/greedy implementation.
